declaration.negotiation_history_statement: The parties reached the settlement through arm’s-length, confidential negotiations. I do not disclose mediation communications or characterize the sequence of offers. The settlement establishes a $27 million class fund for automatic payments to identified members, with no claim form required. Brightline will separately pay up to $4 million in court-approved fees and expenses; it has not agreed to refrain from opposing the request, and any amount not awarded will benefit the class. The fund is approximately 42% of the $64 million in disputed charges. In my judgment, the certain and prompt recovery is fair in light of the risks of class certification and trial, the delay before trial, and the possibility of no recovery. I request that the Court independently review the settlement and fee request under Rule 23(e).
